findings: DF Parquet opener/mod.rs constant_value_from_stats accepts exact equal non-null min/max plus exact zero nulls as a whole-column literal; it has no proof of NaN absence.
Parquet writer update_stat skips NaNs for FLOAT/DOUBLE and logical Float16; min/max exactness describes bounds rather than proving all rows equal to those bounds.
DF ColumnStatistics has no NaN count. is_singleton and physical filter equivalence also consume min/max, so normalizing only the opener would leave other consumers.
DF metadata summarize_distinct_counts reads footer NDV independently; it does not infer NDV from min==max. Preserve explicit NDV.
Sail infer_file_meta is before listing file-statistics cache insert and aggregation; its logical schema is the schema used to derive these column statistics.
Clearing float bounds loses file-statistics MIN/MAX, singleton substitution and range/equivalence simplification opportunities even on finite-only files; count/null/integer information survives.
Raw footer row-group/page pruning and ordering remain separate, unchanged paths. Nested leaf statistics, nonlisting readers and cache entries injected outside this normalized path are not covered.
scope: Read-only pinned source inspection; no dependency edits, no timing or general Parquet correctness claim
